notes.title: Thanks for an Amazing Steam Next Fest & It's Time to Get Back to Development!
notes.notes:
[h3][i]Hello everyone,[/i][/h3][p][i]We've just wrapped up an amazing Steam Next Fest! A heartfelt thank you to everyone who played our demos, shared valuable feedback, and most importantly, believed in our projects by wishlisting our games during this busy and exciting week![/i][/p][p][i]To all the new players who discovered us and joined us during the festival, we want to give a huge "Welcome!" on behalf of our team. As an independent studio, your interest and support are our greatest source of fuel and motivation.[/i]  
[/p][h3][b]Now, It's Time to Get Back to Development![/b][/h3][p]We've gathered all the valuable feedback and notes we received from you during the festival. In the coming months, we'll be focusing all our energy on turning our games into the content-rich and polished final versions we envision. Your patience and support during this process are invaluable to us. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Follow Our Journey on Our Shared Channels[/b][/h3][p]We are a small team working on two different projects at the same time. That's why we share all news, behind-the-scenes content, and important announcements about our development journey on our shared social media channels. By following us, you can stay up-to-date on the progress of both our games.  
[/p][h3][i]Thank you again for being with us on this exciting journey. We'll be back with more news and updates soon!  [/i][/h3][p][i]
Best,[/i]    

[i]Bavsimus[/i]
[b][i]Zero Task[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Where did the trees come from?
notes.notes:
This week, we have exciting news for you! Check it out:

[url=https://zerotaskstudios.com/2025/04/20/where-did-these-trees-come-from/]Click me and find out what happened to Ash and why the game is named "808" just kidding we won't spoil the game. But we have some info about development so... Yeah[/url]

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207489/4f390f8af5fbf8f742fef38940fc527d284f18ef.png[/img]

In 808, you'll take on the role of [b]Ash[/b]. Ash is a human being (like you and me and him). Some of the things in life makes him happy, some makes him sad. And like every human he has some good experiences and some traumatic ones.

Ash signed to this thing called "[b]Recollection Services[/b]" by a company named [b]Helix Industries[/b]. With Helix Industries help, both you and Ash will re-experience his biggest trauma in his life in order to resolve it. Every level in the game is a memory that Ash has lived through.

808 is a game about being human. And as you may know, being a human is sometimes can be overwhelming. We hope you can find something reflecting to your own life. We regularly write about 808 at our website, you can check the first part of our Devlog here:

[url=https://zerotaskstudios.com/2025/02/19/dev-log-1/]How We’re Warping Reality in 808 (And Why You Should Care)[/url]

We will post more and more from now on, so feel free to share it with your friends and loved ones if you like it. Follow us on X, Instagram and Youtube. We truly believe 808 will be meaningful for so many people.

See you next devlog!

-Zero Task
